description_en: Call DescribeDcdnDomainDetail to get the basic configuration of a specified accelerated domain name
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainDetail获取指定加速域名配置的基本信息
name: DescribeDcdnDomainDetail

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name. You can query only one domain name at a time
parameters.help_zh: 加速域名，仅支持单个域名查询
parameters.name: domain_name

DomainDetail.description_en: The details of the domain name

Cname.description_en: The CNAME that is assigned to the accelerated domain name. You need to add a CNAME record for the accelerated domain name at your DNS service provider
Cname.description_zh: 为加速域名生成的一个CNAME域名，您需要在域名解析服务商处为加速域名配置CNAME解析

Description.description_en: The ICP filing information of the domain name

DomainStatus.description_en:
The status of the accelerated domain name. Valid values:

online: Enabled.

offline: Disabled.

configuring: Configuring.

configure_failed: Configuration failed.

checking: Under review.

check_failed: Review failed
DomainStatus.description_zh:
加速域名运行状态。取值：

online：启用。

offline：停用。

configuring：配置中。

configure_failed：配置失败。

checking：正在审核。

check_failed：审核失败

FunctionType.description_en:
The type of the computing service. Valid values:

routine: program.

image: image.

cloudFunction: function
FunctionType.description_zh:
计算服务类型。取值：
routine：程序。
image：镜像。
cloudFunction：函数

GmtCreated.description_en: The time when the domain name was created

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the domain name was last modified

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group

SSLProtocol.description_en:
Indicates whether the SSL certificate is enabled. Valid values:

on: Enabled.

off: Disabled
SSLProtocol.description_zh:
是否开启SSL证书。取值：

on：开启。

off：关闭

SSLPub.description_en: If HTTPS is enabled, this is the public key of the certificate
SSLPub.description_zh: 如果开启HTTPS，此处为证书公钥

Scene.description_en:
The acceleration scenario. Valid values:

apiscene: API acceleration.

webservicescene: website acceleration.

staticscene: acceleration for videos, images, and text.

(empty): no scenario
Scene.description_zh:
加速场景。支持：
apiscene：API加速。
webservicescene：网站业务加速。
staticscene：视频、图文类加速。
（空）：没有场景

Scope.description_en:
The acceleration region.

domestic (default): the Chinese mainland only.

overseas: global (excluding the Chinese mainland).

global: global
Scope.description_zh:
加速区域。
domestic（默认值）：仅中国内地。
overseas：全球（不包含中国内地）。
global：全球
